description: This file defines the main executable class for the RomRaider application, responsible for initializing and launching the ECU editor, logging, and system setup.

classes.name: ECUExec
classes.description: Main class that initializes the RomRaider Java application, sets up logging, look and feel, and opens the ECU editor window.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Application entry point, performs initial setup and opens the ECU editor.

methods.name: showAlreadyRunningMessage
methods.description: Displays a message indicating the application is already running.

methods.name: containsLoggerArg
methods.description: Checks if command-line arguments specify to start logger in normal or fullscreen mode.

methods.name: openRom
methods.description: Opens a specified ROM image file in the ECU editor.

methods.name: openEditor
methods.description: Initializes and displays the ECU editor UI, and opens a specified ROM if provided.
